meta.name: explore-run
meta.description: Rigor Improve / Rigor Explore run leaf skill for bounded exploratory evidence in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory runs such as small-subset validation, short-cycle guess-and-check, batch sweeps, idle-GPU search, or quick transfer-learning trials, with fair-comparison caveats and no-overclaim summaries in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline execution, conservative training verification, default routing, verified SOTA claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行授权范围内的探索性深度学习实验并产出诚实摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做深度学习研究,需要快速验证实验猜想
copy.tagline_en: Run bounded exploratory deep learning experiments and produce honest summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a deep learning researcher wanting quick small-scale validation runs

howto.what: 如果你授权探索性运行,Claude 会规划小样本验证、短周期试错等候选实验,按成本、成功率、预期收益排序,优先小规模检查,并把含公平性限制、不夸大的摘要写入 explore_outputs/;它只做规划与总结,实际跑命令可交给其他技能。
howto.when: 当研究者明确授权做探索性运行,或任务是做小样本验证、短周期探测、批量扫描等有界探索型试验时触发。没有明确授权、或需要正式训练验证时不会唤醒。

say.text: 我授权做小样本验证:用1%数据跑几步,报告训练是否健康。
say.note: 会规划该试验,并把方案写入探索输出目录。

say.text: 我授权对这些候选做批量扫描,按成本、成功率、预期收益排序。
say.note: 会依据这三个因素筛选并排序候选变体。

say.text: 我授权用闲置GPU跑一次短周期迁移学习试验,并注明公平性限制。
say.note: 会注明对比是否公平,并避免夸大结论。

howto.what_en: When authorized, Claude plans bounded exploratory runs, ranks them by cost/success/expected gain, prefers small or short checks, writes caveated no-overclaim summaries to explore_outputs/, and only plans/summarizes; execution may be delegated to run skills.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory runs, e.g. small-subset validation, short probes, or batch sweeps. Not used without such authorization or for trusted baseline verification.

say_en.text: I authorize an exploratory small-subset run; note fairness limits.
say_en.note: It plans the run and writes outputs to explore_outputs/.

say_en.text: I authorize a batch sweep over these variants; rank by cost, success, gain.
say_en.note: It selects and orders candidates using those three factors.

say_en.text: I authorize a short transfer-learning run on idle GPU; flag caveats.
say_en.note: It will mark fair-comparison limits and avoid overclaiming.
